tldr: 美伊達成重啟荷莫茲海峽的和平協議，全球股市急漲、油價重挫，通膨預期降溫，市場以多頭氣氛迎接因 Juneteenth 假期而縮短的交易週。
台股加權指數在台積電與 AI／半導體供應鏈帶動下站上 45,000 點，延續今年最強勁的一段多頭走勢。
市場焦點轉向今日（6/16–17）登場的兩天期 Fed 利率會議，幾乎篤定維持利率於 3.5%–3.75% 區間不變。
台積電重申 2026 年美元營收成長逾三成，CoWoS 先進封裝需求預估年增約七成，AI 晶片動能維持強勁。
法規面，國稅局釐清父母將預售屋移轉子女的贈與稅認定，金管會則擴大保險業資安長設置與投資範圍規範。

items.title_zh: 台積電與 AI 供應鏈領軍，台股強漲站上 45,000 點
items.title_en: TAIEX storms past 45,000 as TSMC and AI supply chain lead a broad rally
items.summary_zh: 台股加權指數最新一個交易日勁揚約 1,269 點，正式突破 45,000 點大關，權值龍頭台積電大漲約 55 元至 2,365 元附近，扮演攻堅主力。本波延續今年以來最強勁的多週漲勢，半導體與 AI 伺服器供應鏈——晶圓代工、先進封裝、ABF、散熱與被動元件——全面領漲。隨著美伊達成和平協議帶動油價下滑、通膨疑慮降溫，全球風險情緒轉佳，內外資持續加碼大型科技權值股，推升指數續創高檔，盤面買氣集中於 AI 主流題材。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark weighted index surged roughly 1,269 points on the latest session to break through the 45,000 level, propelled by heavyweight Taiwan Semiconductor (TSMC), which jumped NT$55 to around NT$2,365. The advance extended one of the strongest multi-week runs of the year, with the semiconductor and AI-server supply chain — foundry, advanced packaging, ABF, cooling and passive components — doing the heavy lifting. Momentum was reinforced by an improving global risk backdrop after the U.S.–Iran peace deal lowered oil prices and inflation fears, encouraging foreign and domestic institutions to keep adding exposure to large-cap tech leaders.
items.source_name: 經濟日報 — 台股創高

items.title_zh: 內外資持續加碼 AI 主流權值股
items.title_en: Foreign and local institutions keep adding to AI-themed large caps
items.summary_zh: 法人資金動向偏多，三大法人近期偏向買超，外資資金集中於台積電、AI 伺服器族群與台灣 50 正向槓桿 ETF。資金持續流入顯示市場對 AI 資本支出循環仍有續航力的信心；惟指數急漲也使交易所列入注意、處置的個股名單增加，波動升溫。在評價墊高、油價、Fed 會議與創高氛圍交織下，後續能否守穩高檔、量能是否續強，將是觀察重點，盤面追高也需留意短線回檔風險。
items.summary_en: Institutional flows remained constructive, with the three major institutional investors net buyers in recent sessions and foreign capital concentrating on TSMC, AI-server names and leveraged Taiwan-50 ETFs. The persistent inflows underscore confidence that the AI capex cycle still has room to run, though the rapid index gains have prompted the exchange to flag a growing list of stocks for disposal/attention as volatility rises. Investors are watching whether the rally can hold its footing as valuations stretch and global cues — oil, the Fed and the new-high environment — drive day-to-day swings.
items.source_name: 鉅亨網 — 台股盤前要聞

items.title_zh: 台積電重申 2026 年美元營收成長逾三成，AI 需求是根本性
items.title_en: TSMC reaffirms 2026 USD revenue growth above 30% on enduring AI demand
items.summary_zh: 台積電高層重申 2026 年以美元計算的全年營收將成長逾 30%，並強調 AI 晶片需求屬「根本性需求」而非短期循環。經營層指出，AI 應用正從資料中心擴散至個人電腦、智慧型手機、汽車與物聯網裝置，可服務市場持續擴大。憑藉先進製程與封裝的領先地位，台積電被視為 AI 浪潮的關鍵推手與潛在最大贏家。此一展望為台灣整體科技出口的下半年獲利動能提供定錨，也鞏固供應鏈對先進製程與 CoWoS 產能的長線需求預期，牽動相關設備與材料廠投資布局。
items.summary_en: Taiwan Semiconductor's leadership reiterated guidance that full-year 2026 revenue, measured in U.S. dollars, will grow by more than 30%, describing demand for AI silicon as "fundamental" rather than cyclical. Management emphasised that AI is spreading beyond data centres into PCs, smartphones, automotive and IoT devices, broadening the addressable market. With its lead in advanced nodes and packaging, TSMC is positioned as a key enabler — and likely winner — of the AI build-out, anchoring the earnings outlook for Taiwan's entire technology export base heading into the second half of the year.
items.source_name: 風傳媒 — 台積電股東會

items.title_zh: 2026 年 CoWoS 需求估年增約七成，輝達為最大買家
items.title_en: CoWoS advanced-packaging demand seen jumping about 70% in 2026, with Nvidia the biggest buyer
items.summary_zh: 產業預估 2026 年 CoWoS 先進封裝總需求量將達約 115 萬片，年增約 70%，反映 AI 加速器訂單持續放量。其中輝達（NVIDIA）預計就消耗約 683,000 片晶圓，佔總需求近 59%，凸顯 AI 運算支出高度集中於少數面向雲端大廠的晶片設計商。需求暴增使先進封裝產能成為產業關鍵瓶頸，也支撐台積電與其封裝、測試、設備夥伴維持積極資本支出。此趨勢進一步鞏固台灣在全球 AI 硬體供應鏈的核心地位，並帶動上游材料、載板與散熱族群的中長線投資想像。
items.summary_en: Industry forecasts point to total 2026 CoWoS demand reaching roughly 1.15 million wafers, a year-on-year increase of about 70%, as AI accelerator orders accelerate. Nvidia alone is projected to absorb around 683,000 wafers — close to 59% of total demand — underlining the concentration of AI compute spending among a handful of hyperscaler-facing chip designers. The surge keeps advanced-packaging capacity a critical bottleneck for the sector and sustains aggressive capex by TSMC and its packaging, testing and equipment partners, reinforcing Taiwan's central role in the global AI hardware chain.
items.source_name: CMoney 投資網誌 — 台積電法說

items.title_zh: 金管會擴大保險業設置資安長範圍
items.title_en: FSC widens insurance-sector cyber-security chief requirement to more firms
items.summary_zh: 金管會擴大要求須設置專責資訊安全長（資安長）的保險業者範圍，部分業者被要求須於 10 月底前增設該職位。此舉是監理機關在資安與詐騙威脅升高下，全面強化金融業營運韌性與資料保護的一環。對保險公司而言，將提高治理與人力配置要求，顯示主管機關日益將資安量能視為健全風險管理的核心，而非可有可無的後勤功能。後續業者須完成組織調整與人員到位，並建立相應的資安治理與通報機制，以符合監理期待並降低營運中斷風險。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Financial Supervisory Commission has expanded the scope of insurers required to appoint a dedicated chief information security officer, with a group of additional carriers ordered to establish the role by the end of October. The move is part of a broader regulatory push to strengthen operational resilience and data protection across the financial sector amid rising cyber and fraud threats. For insurers it raises governance and staffing requirements, signalling that supervisors increasingly treat information-security capacity as a core part of sound risk management rather than an optional back-office function.
items.source_name: 經濟日報 — 金管會擴大保險業資安長範圍

items.title_zh: 金管會鬆綁保險資金投資公建基建，上限放寬至 15%
items.title_en: Regulator opens NT$1.63 trillion of insurance capital to infrastructure, lifts cap to 15%
items.summary_zh: 金管會擴大保險業可投資的基礎建設範圍，並將相關投資上限放寬至 15%，可望引導龐大的長天期保險資金——市場引述約 1.63 兆元可動用資金——投入公共建設與基礎建設資產。此政策旨在使保險業的長期負債與穩定、具收益的實體資產相互匹配，同時支持國家發展目標。對保險業而言，在利率與商品環境相對艱困之際，提供了新的資金去化管道；惟實際成效仍取決於合適的投資案源與風險控管機制是否到位，後續資金落地節奏與報酬表現值得追蹤。
items.summary_en: The FSC has broadened the range of infrastructure projects insurers may invest in and raised the relevant investment ceiling to 15%, potentially channelling a large pool of long-duration insurance capital — figures cited around NT$1.63 trillion of available funds — toward public-construction and infrastructure assets. The policy aims to match insurers' long-term liabilities with stable, yield-generating real assets while supporting national development goals. For the sector it offers fresh avenues to deploy capital amid a challenging rate and product environment, though execution will hinge on suitable project pipelines and risk controls.
items.source_name: 鉅亨網 — 保險業資金可投基建範圍放寬

items.title_zh: 銀行擴充高資產財管平台，涵蓋基金、境外債、ETF 與信託
items.title_en: Banks broaden high-net-worth wealth platforms across funds, offshore bonds, ETFs and trusts
items.summary_zh: 台灣各銀行持續完善綜合財富管理服務，產品橫跨外幣存款、國內外基金、境外債、海外股票、國內外 ETF、境外結構型商品、信託商品與保險，入門門檻普遍約自新台幣 300 萬元起。產品線之廣，反映業者爭奪富裕與高資產客群的競爭日趨激烈，並朝以理財專員為核心、諮詢導向的顧問模式轉型。對客戶而言擴大了商品選擇與客製化空間；對銀行而言，則凸顯財管手續費收入作為策略性成長引擎的企圖。後續產品適配、KYC 與商品適合度控管，仍是財管業務穩健成長的關鍵。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's banks continue to build out comprehensive wealth-management offerings spanning foreign-currency deposits, domestic and overseas funds, offshore bonds, offshore equities, local and foreign ETFs, offshore structured products, trust products and insurance, with entry thresholds commonly starting around NT$3 million. The breadth reflects intensifying competition for affluent and high-net-worth clients and a shift toward consultation-centred advisory models built around dedicated relationship managers. For clients it widens product choice and customisation; for banks it underscores fee-income ambitions in wealth management as a strategic growth engine.
items.source_name: Money101 — 2026 台灣各銀行財富管理方案比較

items.title_zh: 外商私人銀行以超高資產平台爭取頂級客戶
items.title_en: Foreign private banks court Taiwan's top-tier clients with ultra-high-net-worth platforms
items.summary_zh: 以星展（DBS）為代表的外商業者，持續擴張鎖定台灣最富裕客群的頂級私人銀行服務，最高等級私人客戶的資產門檻達約新台幣 1 億元。此類服務整合全球投資管道、客製化投資組合、信託與傳承規劃及專屬禮遇，加劇與本國銀行在高資產客群的競爭。此趨勢反映台灣財富累積規模擴大，客戶對跨境分散、家族信託架構與專業傳承規劃的需求升高，也促使本國金融機構深化自身私人銀行與傳承顧問量能，以留住資產與客戶關係，避免高端客群外流。
items.summary_en: International players such as DBS continue to expand premier private-banking propositions targeting Taiwan's wealthiest individuals, with top-tier private-client tiers set at asset thresholds reaching around NT$100 million. These offerings bundle global investment access, bespoke portfolio construction, trust and succession-planning services and exclusive privileges, intensifying competition with domestic banks for the high-net-worth segment. The trend reflects the growing pool of Taiwanese wealth seeking cross-border diversification, family-trust structures and professional legacy planning, and pressures local institutions to deepen their own private-banking and succession-advisory capabilities.

items.title_zh: 國稅局釐清父母將預售屋移轉子女的贈與稅認定
items.title_en: Tax authority clarifies gift-tax treatment when parents transfer pre-sale homes to children
items.summary_zh: 財政部臺北國稅局提醒，父母將名下預售屋移轉給子女，因涉及二親等以內親屬間的財產移轉，原則上應申報贈與稅；惟若當事人能提出支付價金的金流證明，經國稅局核認確為買賣行為，則可免予課徵贈與稅。此一說明凸顯家族間不動產交易中，保留並備妥資金流向證明的重要性，以避免被認定為贈與而遭補稅，並降低日後查核時的爭議。納稅人在規劃親屬間財產移轉時，宜事前釐清金流與價金支付安排，確保符合實質課稅原則與相關申報規定。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's National Taxation Bureau of Taipei reminded taxpayers that transferring a pre-sale (off-plan) property from parents to children constitutes a property transfer between relatives within the second degree of kinship and must be reported for gift-tax purposes. However, if the parties can provide proof of payment of the purchase price and the transaction is verified as a genuine sale, it may be exempt from gift tax. The clarification highlights the importance of documenting fund flows in intra-family property dealings to avoid unexpected gift-tax assessments and potential disputes during audits.
items.source_name: ETtoday 財經雲 — 2026 遺贈稅新制

items.title_zh: 2026 贈與稅免稅額維持 244 萬元，擬制遺產修法趨嚴
items.title_en: 2026 gift-tax exemption holds at NT$2.44 million; proposed estate rules tighten "deemed estate"
items.summary_zh: 2026 年贈與稅免稅額維持每一贈與人新台幣 244 萬元，不論贈與次數、財產總額或受贈人數多寡均適用此額度。另一方面，財政部預告修正「擬制遺產」課稅規定：往生者死亡前兩年內贈與親屬的財產，將併入遺產總額課稅，且該筆遺產稅改由受贈人單獨負擔，不再由全體繼承人分攤。此一調整將強化提早、且金流完整的傳承規劃誘因，並可能改變家族安排生前財產移轉的方式。高資產家庭宜重新檢視贈與時點、信託與保單等工具的整體稅務效果，以因應新制可能帶來的稅負與分攤責任變化。
items.summary_en: For 2026, the annual gift-tax exemption stands at NT$2.44 million per donor, applicable regardless of the number of gifts, total value or number of recipients. Separately, the Ministry of Finance has signalled draft amendments to the "deemed estate" rules: property gifted to relatives within two years before death would be folded back into the total taxable estate, with the estate tax borne solely by the recipient of that gift rather than apportioned among all heirs. The changes would sharpen incentives for earlier, well-documented succession planning and reshape how families structure lifetime transfers.
items.source_name: 商周 — 2026 贈與稅全攻略

items.title_zh: Fed 兩天期利率會議今日登場，市場篤定維持 3.5%–3.75%
items.title_en: Fed's two-day FOMC meeting begins today; markets price near-certain hold at 3.5%–3.75%
items.summary_zh: 美國聯準會 6 月決策會議於 6/16–17 召開，市場隱含的「按兵不動」機率接近確定（約 99.6%），預期聯邦資金利率目標區間維持在 3.5%–3.75%。通膨數據平穩、勞動市場具韌性，加上 Fed 強調數據依賴，使暫停升降息成為共識。在 Powell 於 5 月中卸任主席、央行領導層更迭的背景下，投資人將緊盯會後聲明與利率點陣圖，尋找未來降息時點的線索。尤其美伊協議使近期通膨壓力降溫，市場關注 Fed 是否釋出較偏鴿的訊號，牽動美元、美債殖利率與全球風險性資產的後續走向。
items.summary_en: The Federal Reserve's June policy meeting runs June 16–17, with market-implied odds of no change running near certainty (around 99.6%) and the federal funds target range expected to stay at 3.5%–3.75%. Steady inflation readings, a resilient labour market and the Fed's emphasis on data dependence have anchored expectations for a pause. The backdrop is complicated by the recent leadership transition after Jerome Powell stepped down as chair in mid-May; investors will scrutinise the statement and projections for signals on the timing of any future cuts, especially as the U.S.–Iran deal eases the near-term inflation picture.

items.title_zh: 美伊協議激勵風險情緒，亞股全面大漲、南韓 Kospi 領軍
items.title_en: Asian markets surge as Iran deal lifts risk appetite, Kospi leads region
items.summary_zh: 亞洲股市對美伊和平架構與油價下跌作出強勁反應，南韓 Kospi 開盤勁揚逾 4% 領漲區域，日本日經 225 指數上漲約 3.5%、東證指數（Topix）亦漲逾 2%。此波同步上揚反映市場對中東緊張緩和、荷莫茲海峽可望重啟的樂觀，認為能降低仰賴進口能源的亞洲經濟體的能源成本與通膨風險，強化全球「風險偏好」氛圍，同步帶動台股與華爾街走高。投資人後續仍將觀察協議落實進度與油價走勢，作為亞股能否延續多頭的關鍵變數。
items.summary_en: Asian equities rallied strongly in reaction to the U.S.–Iran peace framework and falling oil prices, with South Korea's Kospi leading regional gains by climbing over 4% at the open while Japan's Nikkei 225 added around 3.5% and the Topix gained over 2%. The synchronised advance reflected relief that an easing of Middle East tensions and the prospective reopening of the Strait of Hormuz would lower energy costs and inflation risk across import-dependent Asian economies, reinforcing the global "risk-on" tone that also propelled Taiwan and Wall Street higher.
